modules.description: The modules the game uses (module.ts, docs/engine-split.md §4), installed in this order with every engine made over it.

deeds.description: What people take as deeds (docs/npc-sandbox.md §2.2), the watches, the numbers of their social life.

loot.description: What a felled creature's kind leaves its feller beyond the rules' spoils: its own piece's pity and words (the loot module).

talk.description: The verbs of the talk panel (docs/npc-sandbox.md §2.9): each offered when its condition holds (host: the one spoken to; actor: the speaker).

resistances.description: Each element's resistance: the stat that takes a share of its harm away (percent; below 0, more harm), world-model.md §6.8.

instanceTags.description: Tags an instance may carry beyond its type's (materials, qualities…); used by conflict checks.

factions.description: Factions (an actor belongs to those its `faction:<id>` tags name) and whom each is hostile to.

professions.description: Professions by id (the `profession` prop, an item's `profession:<id>` tag), for their names.

thresholds.description: Numeric lines that are events when a prop crosses them (design.md §5.7: threshold).

materials.description: The materials things are made of, by id.

sets.description: Sets of gear (`props.set` on each piece): worn together, so many pieces give more (World.stat adds each bonus whose `pieces` the worn count reaches) — the sum of its `props`, read as any worn number is.

affixes.description: Gear's rolled extras (affixes.ts): how many a piece rolls when it is made, and from what.

kits.description: The creatures' own skills (the kits module, docs/creatures.md), by type: a kind's kit is the nearest its type or an ancestor names. How a skill is aimed and timed is here; what it does where it lands is its host's rule (`act/use` with the param `kit`).

efficiency.description: How well an instrument works on a material category (world-model.md §6.1): rows are its capabilities (`tool:axe` …) and its edge (`edge:cut` …); an instrument takes its best row. A category no row names: 1.

roomRoles.description: What makes a room what it is (world-model.md §5.4, RimWorld's roles, as tags): a room with `count` things matching `needs` in it has the tag `role:<role>`, and the role's props (a bedroom's `rest`: how much a night's sleep there gives back).

periods.description: Clocks that make `time/period` events for the hosts they name.

appear.description: What appears by itself on any map its `where` fits (the night's walkers), besides each map's own (MapData.appear).

goals.description: The order goals are tried in for a thing whose type does not say (world-model.md §6.10).

looks.description: The looks bodies are drawn from (docs/looks.md): bodies, parts, colours.

OntologyPart.description: An ontology file: a part of the ontology; its types, statuses and terrains as lists or as records by id.

own.description: The one thing this kind was made for (the editor's "its own kind", docs/engine-split.md §16 E-b): rules on it are that thing's alone. The engine reads nothing from it.

tags.description: Tags inherited by every instance (instances may add more).

sprite.description: Render key; resolved by the client's art layer (`art:<type id>` for a type that carries its own `art`).

art.description: Its own picture, for a type a patch introduced (sprite `art:<id>`).

solid.description: Does it block movement? (it fills its cell's volume; a body blocks by its own space)

occupies.description: The spaces it takes in its cell (world-model.md §5.2): in a cell each space has at most one occupant. Default: a body for an agent that does not fly, the volume for a solid thing, none for the rest (items and most furniture share a cell with anything).

terrain.description: It is drawn as the ground of its cell, this terrain (the cell things of a map's data; world-model.md §4.6).

makeup.description: What it is made of, which is also what it leaves when it breaks (world-model.md §6.4): each part's count is scaled by the world's recovery rate, in the thing's own material.

stage.description: How long it stays what it is, and what it becomes (world-model.md §6.5).

goals.description: The order its goals are tried in (world-model.md §6.10): encounter, threat, follow, schedule, home, idle.

station.description: Where it is made from its makeup (world-model.md §6.4): `hands` (anywhere), or a station a thing within reach is (its `station:<x>` tag).

craftLevel.description: The level its recipe asks (default 1): a maker above it makes it finer.

tools.description: Tools its making needs carried (tags: `tool:axe`), not used up (Elin's tool requirement).

yields.description: How many one making gives (a log splits into two planks); what one breaks back into is its share of the makeup.

footprint.description: Things bigger than a tile: the base they stand on, [width, depth] in tiles — centred on their own tile, reaching back (north) from it. A solid thing blocks all of it, and only while it is there. Default [1, 1].

reach.description: The stances it acts on: what can stand or lie on it (none by default). A thing's own stance is its `stance` prop.

TypeDef.description: A type of thing (world-model.md §4). There are no kinds: everything descends from the one root, and whatever the engine asks of a thing is data here, inherited down the type path (the tags `agent` — acts by itself with a body — and `portable`, the stances it `reach`es, its props).

PixelArt.description: A 16x16 icon as data: one string per row, one character per pixel ("." transparent), each other character a colour of the palette. Things the world learned carry their own picture this way (the client draws it), so it travels with the patch like the rest of the type.

Space.description: The spaces of a cell (world-model.md §5.2): what one stands on, what fills it, what roots in it, a body.

MakeupPart.description: A part of what a thing is made of: `count` of `type`, each with `chance` (default 1).

into.description: What it becomes at the end; none: it stays what it is and the stage begins again (a hen lays, and lays again).

lasts.description: Ticks the stage lasts, its clock (the status `stage`) started when the thing comes to be what it is.

clock.description: Another status as its clock, started by whatever gives it (a crop moves on when its watering runs out): then nothing starts it by itself.

needs.description: A condition on the thing (the host) the end waits for (light, nobody standing on it); not met, it waits `wait` ticks and looks again.

fx.description: What is seen at the end (a vfx: leaves, a splash).

yields.description: What the end leaves where it is (an egg laid).

StageDef.description: A stage (world-model.md §6.5, after Elin's GrowSystem, generalised): a thing stays what it is until its clock runs out, then becomes the next (a stump a tree, thin ice water) and leaves what the stage yields (a hen's egg). One mechanism for every such change; it runs on timers, so a dormant map catches up when it is entered.

stacks.description: Count the slots they take rather than the things: a slot holds STACK_MAX of one stack key.

adding.description: Count as if one more of this role's thing were among them (does the one at hand still fit).

type.description: Is-a match against the type hierarchy (prefix on slash paths): `actor`, `item/food`, `tile/grass`…

Selector.description: Selects the entity or tile filling a role. All given constraints must hold.

Reader.description: What a condition may read: the event's roles, and the stewards every rule may read (the story, the world).

Bounds.description: Numeric bounds whose limits may be read from roles. A missing property fails the test.

Operand.description: A number, or a number read from a role's prop (scaled) or from the event's params.

duration.description: Default duration in ticks; omitted = until removed.

clears.description: Statuses removed when this one is applied (e.g. frozen removes burning).

wards.description: Statuses that cannot take hold while this one lasts (fireproof wards off burning).

immobilize.description: An actor with this status cannot move or act.

moveDelay.description: Multiplier on movement delay while held (e.g. dream mist slows any actor).

every.description: Ticks between the status's time/period events (default 5): a bleed pulses once a second.

overlay.description: What the client draws over a thing that has it: one of OVERLAYS (an unknown one draws nothing).

props.description: What it adds to its holder's stats while held (world-model.md §6.8): fireproof's resistance to fire.

liquid.description: Swimmable/liquid terrain: items put here are not simply dropped.

reach.description: The stances it acts on (default `ground` for a floor, none for the rest): what touches it (design.md §5.5).

space.description: The space it takes in its cell (default `floor`): ground is a floor; trees, rock and walls fill the volume; a stump roots in the soil.

props.description: Its props as a thing (its material, its durability: maxHp and hp).

stage.description: How long it stays what it is, and what it becomes (TypeDef.stage).

told.description: How it is told ({who} did it, against {whom}, to {what}): "{who} stole {what} from {whom}".

weight.description: Regard lost by its victim (others who learn of it lose a share).

violent.description: Violence: those who see it fear the doer; the fighting answer.

rank.description: The worst first: a deed matched earlier hides the lesser ones in the same act (murder hides assault).

DeedDef.description: A kind of deed (docs/npc-sandbox.md §2.2): what in a `seen` event makes it one — a condition on the event (roles actor, target, instrument; params act, owner: mine|ours|another|nobody, from: person|container|ground, harm, killed, presence) — and what it costs: a fine (`value`: half the thing's worth) and the regard it takes.

jail.description: Where its jail is: a map and an anchor on it.

unpardonable.description: A bounty this high is not talked or bought away (a murderer's).

LawDef.description: A watch (docs/npc-sandbox.md §2.7): who keeps the law on its maps, and where it keeps those who will not pay.

coin.description: The coin trade and fines are paid in.

regardStart.description: Regard one starts with toward a stranger, and toward one tied to them.

talk.description: Talking raises regard by this once a day (harder as it rises).

fade.description: How fast regard fades back to its start, each day (a share of the way).

gossipEvery.description: Ticks between two rounds of gossip, and how many days a deed stays worth telling.

perceiveEvery.description: Ticks between two looks about (trespass, the wanted, a drawn blade, a familiar description).

fearTicks.description: How long one fears a violent doer, in ticks.

markup.description: How much a merchant asks over a thing's value, and pays under it; and a fence's share for what is not yours.

fadeUp.description: How fast regard above its start fades back, each day (a share of the way): slower than a grudge heals. Default `fade`.

discount.description: The share off what a merchant asks one it holds in full regard (100), and in proportion below (default 0.2).

residence.description: Where people held in full regard may be asked to come and live (a home ground): `moveIn`.

SocialParams.description: The numbers of the people's social life (data, docs/npc-sandbox.md): the engine holds the mechanisms.

at.description: The regard (of the one asked toward the one asking) it takes: one a liking keeps for days as it fades.

days.description: A resident's day there, hour by hour: each span spent at its bed (`bed`) or its bed's day place (`day`), and doing what.

ResidenceDef.description: A home ground's room for people (the society module's `moveIn`): its map and the beds it has, each an anchor there (where the resident sleeps; `<anchor>.day` where their day is spent, else the same), open once its fact holds; a resident's day there; what the one asked says, moved in or with no bed free.

pity.description: How many of a kind one fells without its piece before the next surely gives it (default 50; the count is the feller's `trophy.<type>`).

found.description: What the one at the keys is told when a piece comes to them (`{item}`: its name); none, only the piece's pickup is shown.

LootParams.description: The loot module's numbers and words (packages/modules/src/loot): a creature kind's own piece of gear (its type's `trophy` prop, found by its `trophyChance`) comes to the one who fells it by that chance, or surely after so many.

label.description: What the panel says ({bounty}, {bribe}, {name} are filled in).

when.description: Offered when this holds (host: the one spoken to; actor: the speaker).

arrest.description: A guard's, offered only when the guard has stopped the speaker (an arrest), and then only these.

TalkVerb.description: A verb of the talk panel: what it is called, when it is offered, and its sub-choices (a request's).

hostile.description: Factions its members attack on sight (when their temper says so).

lte.description: Crossed when the value comes to this or below.

below.description: Or crossed when it comes under this share of another prop of the thing (hungry: under 60 % of maxHunger).

both.description: Crossed back as well: the value rises over the line again (the event's param `way` is `up`).

name.description: How a thing of it is named ("Stone" Axe, 石斧), what tags it gives.

attack.description: How much it makes of a weapon's or tool's power, and of a worn thing's defence (world-model.md §6.8, Elin's material atk/pv): factors, 1 when absent.

value.description: What it makes of a thing's worth (docs/npc-sandbox.md §2.10): a factor, 1 when absent.

MaterialDef.description: A material (world-model.md §4.5): its category (what tools work on: wood, stone, ore, flesh …) and its hardness — an instrument softer than what it strikes does nothing (Elin: a tool below the material's level). Things carry theirs as a `material:<id>` tag, or their type's `material` prop.

value.description: What it makes of a thing's worth: a factor, 1 when absent.

vows.description: What a piece of gear of this quality carries beyond its numbers: made, it takes one of these as its `vow` (a combat module answers each by id: the Vowbound's vows), unless its kind or the maker names one.

QualityDef.description: A quality a made thing can have (world-model.md §6.4): its tag, name and factor on power and defence (Elin's rarity), and from how far above a recipe's level its maker reaches it (none: not by making).

GearSet.description: A set of gear: its pieces carry `props.set: id`; worn together they give its bonuses.

AffixTable.description: The world's table of extras: how many a piece rolls, and the pool they come from.

name.description: What a tooltip calls it (default: its key), and whether its value is a share, shown as a percentage (0.05: 5%).

AffixDef.description: One extra a piece may roll: a stat key, its range and step, the slots it may roll on (all, if none), how often.

shape.description: The cells it marks: a disk around its centre (`circle`), a line one wide ahead of it (`line`, `radius` long), a cone ahead (`cone`), a cross through its centre (`cross`).

aim.description: Its centre: the creature itself, or the foe's cell when it winds up (locked: a foe that moves away is missed).

move.description: How it gets there: it leaps onto the aimed cell (a free one beside it when that is taken), or dashes along the line to the first foe or the first thing in the way. Without it, it stands where it is.

back.description: Having hit, it springs back so many cells from the one it struck (a bat's swoop).

range.description: The foe's distance (in cells, the greater axis) at which it may take the skill up: [nearest, farthest].

aligned.description: A line or a cone, and a dash, is taken up only when the foe stands in a row or a column with it.

cooldown.description: Ticks before it may take this skill up again.

chance.description: The chance it takes the skill up when it could (looked at once a second): default 1.

below.description: Taken up only under this share of its full health (a crab that shells up when hurt).

color.description: The marks' colour (0xRRGGBB); default the warning red.

CreatureSkill.description: A creature's skill (the kits module, docs/creatures.md): when its behaviour takes it up, how long it winds up on the cells it marks, and how it gets there. Ticks at 10 a second.

recovery.description: The share of its makeup a thing leaves when it breaks (D9).

spawnMax.description: How many things one effect may make at once (a runtime guard; default 64).

safeFall.description: A drop of this many levels or less does no harm (world-model.md §5.5).

fallDamage.description: The harm of each level fallen beyond the safe height.

rainCost.description: How much longer a long step takes in rain, a storm or snow (a map with a `scale`).

storeys.description: How many storeys may stand above the ground (world-model.md §5.2).

roomSize.description: The largest a room may be, in cells: larger is out of doors (world-model.md §5.4).

riseHour.description: The hour one rises; and how much of what is missing a night's sleep gives back outside a room that says more.

reach.description: How far a hand or a thing used reaches when the thing does not say (`handsRange` on what is handled, `range` on what is used): cells round, the actor's own included.

carry.description: How far one takes and puts things (F, G): cells round, the actor's own included.

slotCount.description: How many of a body's wearing slots there are of a kind, where more than one (two hands, two rings): `wear:ring`, `wear:ring.2`.

nightFact.description: The story's fact that lengthens the night by so many hours (a number; the Ford's `night.shift`): none, the night keeps its length.

gearLevels.description: Gear's levels (world-model.md §6.8, 2026-10-13): a piece of gear has a `level` from 1 to `max`; each level above the first adds `perLevel` to the factor on its main stats (power, defence, attack: ×(1 + perLevel·(level − 1)); its shares — a crit chance, a dodge — half as much), and `affixPerLevel` to the factor on what its rolled extras may reach; `affixCount` is how many extras a piece of each quality rolls (a quality not named: the table's count).

WorldParams.description: Numbers the world is made with (world-model.md §11): data, never literals in the engine.

host.description: Things on the active map that have it (a selector), or a resident host.

everyProp.description: A prop on the host that overrides `every` for it (Iron Stomach's slower hunger: `hungerEvery`).

paceBy.description: Statuses that slow it for a host that has them: its interval times this (asleep, hunger comes four times slower).

on.description: The grounds it appears on (terrain ids); any ground one can stand on when absent.

max.description: At most this many on the map: those tagged `tag` if it is given, else those of its types.

every.description: Ticks between appearances (a multiple of the `appear` period).

ring.description: How far from the one at the keys, [near, far] cells (default: anywhere, not within two).

hours.description: When: hours [from, to) (past midnight when from > to), and weathers.

night.description: When: at night, however long the story's night has grown (World.isNight; instead of hours).

where.description: Which maps (for the world's own): by the map's zone and light.

tag.description: A tag what appears carries (counted by `max`).

temper.description: When it attacks those its factions are hostile to: always, after dark only, or only once provoked. Whoever strikes it becomes a foe, whatever its temper.

foes.description: Whoever struck it: attacked on sight.

leash.description: How far from where it lives (home, or its night roam) it will chase before it gives up (default 8).

detour.description: The way around an obstacle it is following, to the goal it was planned for.

noWay.description: A goal no way led to (one shut in a house): it does not look for a way there again until then.

night.description: Where it roams at night (creatures come out after dark); by day it keeps to `home`.

ai.description: A creature's behaviour (its home is where it appears), and statuses it appears with.

AppearDef.description: What appears by itself (world-model.md §6.9; Don't Starve's twigs and flint, Minecraft's mobs, the night's walkers): data only. Now and then one more of the weighted types appears on a free cell of the right ground, at the right distance from the one at the keys, at the right hours and weather, until `max` of them are on the map.

z.description: The storey (world-model.md §5.2): 0 the ground's, 1 the floor above it … (omitted: 0).

materials.description: The colour a worn thing shows in, by its material (an iron helmet is iron-grey): `#rrggbb` or a colour id.

LookTable.description: The looks a world knows (Ontology.looks): bodies, parts and colours; the engine checks a look against it and derives its tags.

LookBodyDef.description: A body a look may have: its sex and age as a body shows them, and what it says of its bearer.

bodies.description: The bodies it is drawn for (omitted: every body).

colors.description: Its own colour keys' defaults (`1` → a colour id) and the shared keys it uses (`hair`, `skin`, `eyes`).

LookPartDef.description: A part of a look: the slot it fills, the bodies it fits, the colour keys it is painted in, and its tags.

for.description: Families it is offered for: hair, skin, eyes, cloth, metal.

LookColorDef.description: A named colour: what it is called, and the tags it gives the key it colours (silver hair → `look:grey-haired`).
